description: An engineering manager must authorize the commissioning of a new robotic palletizer beside the finished-goods line and finalize the electrical, controls-validation, and staffing arrangements for the commissioning window, with input from environmental health and safety, controls engineering, and production supervision.

shared_context.S1: A new robotic palletizer is installed beside the finished-goods line, and the existing manual palletizing process can continue while the robot is commissioned.
shared_context.S2: Elena makes the final authorization decision for the commissioning work.
shared_context.S3: The commissioning is planned for Thursday, and production needs a finalized work window and operating controls before the shift schedule is published.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal pre-commissioning review, Elena checks with environmental health and safety, controls engineering, and production supervision before authorizing the work.
shared_context.S5: Before authorization, the safety, controls, and production prerequisites must be documented in their respective work records, and each owner must confirm the required pre-Thursday action is complete.
shared_context.S6: The final commissioning record must use a name-only value for the certified operator, set each completed required control and schedule action to true, and record the corresponding owner commitments before authorization.

PF1.text: Ravi's completed arc-flash review found that the palletizer control cabinet requires a 3-meter electrical exclusion zone and documented independent lockout verification before commissioning; he completed the review yesterday, but the safety file has not yet been updated.

PF2.text: Maya received the vendor's commissioning procedure by email after the installation: the updated robot software requires a 3-hour dry run covering exactly 40 test cycles before cartons may be processed; she has not yet entered the procedure in the controls work order.

PF3.text: Jon's current roster shows that Nora is the only certified palletizer operator available Thursday from 13:00 to 16:00, so commissioning must use that exact window; the roster was finalized after the preliminary commissioning plan was circulated.

decisions.commissioning_authorized: boolean; true only after all three owners have revealed their facts and committed to their required actions
decisions.certified_operator: string; output the clean name only, exactly Nora
decisions.controls_work_order_updated: boolean; set true because Maya must enter the vendor procedure before Thursday
decisions.production_schedule_locked: boolean; set true because Jon must lock the schedule with Nora in the exact Thursday window

acceptance_conditions: Commissioning must occur Thursday from 13:00 to 16:00.
The commissioning window must last exactly 3 hours.
The electrical exclusion zone must be exactly 3 meters.
Independent lockout verification must be required before commissioning.
The dry run must cover exactly 40 test cycles.
Nora must be assigned as the certified operator using the clean name-only value Nora.
The controls work order must be updated with the vendor procedure before Thursday.
The production schedule must be locked with Nora assigned to the Thursday 13:00 to 16:00 commissioning window.
The arc-flash review must be cited as justification.
A safety commitment must require the 3-meter exclusion zone and independent lockout verification.

content_checks.C2: decisions['commissioning_day'] == 'Thursday' and decisions['commissioning_start_time'] == '13:00' and decisions['commissioning_end_time'] == '16:00' and decisions['commissioning_duration_hours'] == 3 and decisions['certified_operator'] == 'Nora'
content_checks.C6: decisions['dry_run_cycles'] == 40 and any(c['target'] == 'Maya' and 'controls work order' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: decisions['certified_operator'] == 'Nora' and decisions['commissioning_day'] == 'Thursday' and decisions['commissioning_start_time'] == '13:00' and decisions['commissioning_end_time'] == '16:00' and any(c['target'] == 'Jon' and 'Nora' in c['detail'] and '13:00' in c['detail'] and '16:00' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['target'] == 'Ravi' and '3-meter' in c['detail'] and ('lockout' in c['detail'] or 'LOTO' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The arc-flash review changes the electrical controls from a generic commissioning setup to exactly a 3-meter exclusion zone, mandatory independent lockout verification, and a matching safety commitment.
The vendor procedure changes controls validation to exactly 40 dry-run cycles and changes the controls work-order requirement to entering the procedure before Thursday.
The roster changes the work plan to Thursday 13:00-16:00 with Nora as the certified operator and changes the production commitment to document that exact assignment.
